description: Fetch reviewer comments for a briefroom share URL (or raw token) as an AI-agent-optimized Markdown prompt by default, or JSON. Public API — works without auth, but auth returns owner-only fields.

format.description: prompt = Markdown for AI agents (default). json = machine-readable.

locale.description: Language of the returned Markdown. Defaults to OS locale.

share.description: Share URL (https://.../s/<token>) or raw base32 token (17 or 32 chars).

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Return only comments updated after this instant.

status.description: Filter comments by status. Defaults to all.

name: get_feedback
